# ship

Deploy containers to your own VPS. Build, push, run — one command.

## Docs

- Getting Started: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/getting-started/
- Commands: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/commands/
- Secrets & Keys: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/secrets/
- Deploy: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/deploy/
- Migration: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/migrating/
- Configuration: https://leviyehonatan.github.io/ship/configuration/

## Repo

- https://github.com/leviyehonatan/ship
- Install: go install github.com/leviyehonatan/ship@v0.2.0
